summary.text: Jack Whitver is a Republican state senator for Iowa Senate District 23 and has served in the Iowa Senate since 2011.

paragraphs.text: The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Whitver as an entrepreneur and attorney with a B.S. and M.B.A. from Iowa State University and a law degree from Drake University (2012), born in 1980 in Knoxville, raised in Grinnell and living in Grimes.
The Iowa Senate Republicans' biography page says Whitver was elected Senate President in November 2016 and Senate Majority Leader in March 2018.
